nepal: Long narrow northwest-to-southeast strip with rugged dense mountain ridges along the northern/top edge, parallel foothills and a flat continuous narrow southern/bottom plain. Preserve all fragments on shared backing and own reference contour.
mongolia: Very wide east-west mainland, taller mountainous west, strong west/central ridges, northern top-center tall stepped bump, broad flatter eastern/southeastern body and narrow irregular far-east projection. Preserve own wide proportions and ridge/flat distribution; no islands or invented peaks across flat east.
iran: Broad diagonal northwest-to-southeast mainland with tall northwest projection, deep concave top/northern coastline, curved northern mountain belt, long diagonal rugged western/southwestern ridges, broad flatter central/eastern plateau and angled southeastern tail. Preserve tiny detached southern coastal islands/fragments and own silhouette.
iraq: Compact polygonal country with long angular straight southwestern edge and broad smooth western/southern plains. Rugged mountain ridges concentrated along north/northeast boundary, smooth central riverplain, stepped narrow southeastern corner. Preserve own low-relief distribution; do not invent mountains across plains.
